basedOn: Round 1 of the trial batch ran P11 and P28; the reviewer's notes are verify-trial-r1-C.md and verify-trial-r1-D.md in this folder. The top-level conventions in plan.json apply to every package here.
notes: Round 1: UX-303, UX-412 and UX-413 verified fixed; UX-421 partly fixed; round check passed; no failing tests. The regressions R1C-1, R1C-2, R1D-1 and R1D-2 are now UX-425, UX-426, UX-427 and UX-428.

UX-421 isn't re-planned. Its 12 sp part shipped in P28. What's left, Catalan `Configuració` fitting its tab at 320 dp and 1.3× text, needs U13's two tabs, whose timing is an open decision, so it moves to Decision needed with U13. P28's device check asked for it by mistake. It isn't escalated: it has failed once, and what blocks it is a decision, not a failed fix.

Seen in passing in verify-trial-r1-C.md (older than P11, so not regressions): UX-429 (the `Todos los proyectos` sheet leaves no room for the keyboard), UX-430 (a Proyectos search with no match shows nothing) and UX-431 (the time-zone search ignores accents). They aren't in this round. They were added to P24, P26 and P18 in plan.json, the main-batch packages that already edit those files.

packages.title: Tab labels fit at 320 dp; tab icons match their screens
files: a tab-bar widget test that loads Manrope (for ux-tester)
brief: Round 2 of the trial batch. In round 1, P28 made the tab labels 12 sp, selected w800 in `onSurface` and unselected w500 in `onSurfaceVariant` (App/lib/theme/app_theme.dart:122-129), and gave every tab an outlined/filled icon pair (App/lib/screens/main_shell.dart:52-71). The reviewer verified UX-412 and UX-413 as fixed and found two regressions, written up as R1D-1 and R1D-2 in .claude/ux-review/runs/2026-10-13-app/verify-trial-r1-D.md; they are now UX-427 and UX-428. Keep everything P28 did; this package corrects two side effects.

UX-427 (R1D-1): Spanish `Calendario` breaks mid-word on narrow phones. The label style sets no letter spacing, so the label inherits 0.25 from `bodyMedium` through the bar's Material, and NavigationBar caps label scaling at 1.3×. At that cap, `Calendario` is 86.9 dp selected and 82.4 dp unselected, in an 80 dp tab (a 320 dp screen split four ways). It wraps to `Calendari` with `o` below, and the icon and its pill rise over the bar's top border. It happens below about 348 dp with text at 1.2× or more, on the tab the app opens on. Before P28 it was 78.5 dp and fit.

Fix, part 1: add `letterSpacing: 0` to the TextStyle the label resolver returns (app_theme.dart:124-128). Keep `fontFamily: 'Manrope'`, `fontSize: 12`, and the w800/`onSurface` and w500/`onSurfaceVariant` states.

Fix, part 2: in MainShell.build, when `MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width < 360`, wrap the NavigationBar (main_shell.dart:48-73, inside the DecoratedBox) in `MediaQuery.withClampedTextScaling(maxScaleFactor: 1.2, child: …)`. At 360 dp and wider, leave it unwrapped, so labels still reach Flutter's own 1.3× cap.

The reviewer's measurement, from Manrope's metrics, which match the current render to within about 1 dp: `Calendario` becomes 77.9 dp selected and 73.7 dp unselected inside 80 dp, drawn at 14.4 px. That's no smaller than the 14.3 px the labels reached before P28.
How it fits U13 (two tabs, 160 dp each at 320 dp; approved in principle, timing still open): this is a stopgap for four tabs, and the clamp can go when U13 lands. Don't build U13.

Out of scope: Catalan `Configuració` still won't fit one tab at 320 dp, even with both parts (about 93 dp selected at 1.2×, scaling the reviewer's figures). That's UX-421, which now waits on U13. Don't rename it: it's Android's own Catalan word for Settings, and app_ca.arb:614 and :618 send people there. Don't clamp below 1.2, and don't change `labelBehavior` or the bar's 72 dp height.

UX-428 (R1D-2): one concept, two icons. The tabs now show `check_box` (Tareas) and `description` (Notas), but inside the screens the same concepts still use the icons the tabs had before P28. Use each tab's outlined icon there:
- home_screen.dart:233, the empty state shared by Tareas and project pages: `Icons.checklist_rounded` → `Icons.check_box_outlined`;
- notes_screen.dart:111, the Notas empty state, and notes_screen.dart:170, every note row's leading icon: `Icons.notes_rounded` → `Icons.description_outlined`;
- home_screen.dart:132, the `Notas` button on a project page: `Icons.notes_rounded` → `Icons.description_outlined`.

Leave alone: the tab icons in main_shell.dart; `Icons.task_alt_rounded` for completed tasks, a different concept; voice_task_screen.dart:953 and captures_screen.dart:49, which P35, P39 and P43 replace.

No copy changes, so no ARB edits and no gen-l10n. The existing tab tests (App/test/appearance_test.dart:416-499) run at 390×844, where nothing is clamped, and check size, weight, colour and icons; they should pass unchanged.
acceptance: Widget test (load Manrope and MaterialIcons with FontLoader, as App/test/calendar_feedback_test.dart:28-35 does): the app shell in Spanish on a 320×640 surface at text scale 1.3, first with Calendario selected and then with Tareas selected: each tab label (`Calendario`, `Tareas`, `Notas`, `Ajustes`) lays out on one line, i.e. its height is that of a single line of its style.

Widget test: the same holds in Spanish at 320×640 with text scale 2.0, and in English (`Calendar`, `Tasks`, `Notes`, `Settings`) at 320×640 with text scale 1.3. Catalan isn't asserted: `Configuració` is UX-421, which waits on U13.

Widget test: at 320×640 with text scale 2.0 the tab labels are drawn at 14.4 px (12 × 1.2); at 390×844 with text scale 1.3 they are drawn at 15.6 px (12 × 1.3), so phones 360 dp and wider keep the larger labels.
Code: the tab label TextStyle in app_theme.dart sets `letterSpacing: 0`, and main_shell.dart clamps text scaling to 1.2 only when the screen is narrower than 360 dp.

Widget test: an empty Tareas list shows `Icons.check_box_outlined`; an empty Notas list and every note row show `Icons.description_outlined`; a project page's `Notas` button shows `Icons.description_outlined`.
grep: no `notes_rounded` and no `checklist_rounded` in App/lib/screens/home_screen.dart or App/lib/screens/notes_screen.dart.
Render: in the calendar-feedback previews (390 dp, light and dark), the selected tab is still bold with a filled icon, as after P28.
deviceChecks: Spanish, Android font size at its largest, on a phone narrower than 360 dp (or a 360 dp phone with Display size raised): every tab label sits on one line and the tab icons stay inside the bar. Inferred from font metrics; the widget test covers the layout.

packages.title: Search keeps matching while you type; empty search does no work
brief: Round 2 of the trial batch. In round 1, P11 added `matchesSearch` and `foldForSearch` (App/lib/services/text_search.dart) and moved all four searches onto them: Tareas and project pages (home_screen.dart:213), Notas (notes_screen.dart:98), Proyectos (task_lists_screen.dart:366) and the `Todos los proyectos` sheet (project_scope_control.dart:137). The reviewer verified UX-303 as fixed and found two severity-1 regressions in the helper, written up as R1C-1 and R1C-2 in .claude/ux-review/runs/2026-10-13-app/verify-trial-r1-C.md; they are now UX-425 and UX-426. Change only text_search.dart; the four callers stay as they are.

UX-425 (R1C-1): typing `col·` briefly says nothing matches. The pair rule (`l[·.]l|ŀl` → `ll`, text_search.dart:9 and :19) folds only when both l's are there. The stored `col·legi` becomes `collegi`, but a query typed one key at a time passes through `col·`, `col.` or `coŀ`, which keep their dot. For that keystroke, Notas and Tareas show `No hi ha tasques que coincideixin`, the sheet shows `No s’han trobat projectes`, and Proyectos goes blank, just as a Catalan user hunts for the `·` key. Before P11, these matched.
Fix: fold one character at a time.
- In foldForSearch, `·` (U+00B7) folds to nothing and `ŀ` (U+0140, which `Ŀ` lowercases to) folds to `l`: add both to the per-character map. `l·l` and `ŀl` then become `ll` on their own.
- Narrow the regex at :19 to the full-stop spelling: `l.l` → `ll`, with a literal dot.
- In matchesSearch, if the folded query ends in `l.`, drop that final `.`, so `col.` searches as `col`.
Nothing changes on screen, and there's no copy.

UX-426 (R1C-2): an empty search still folds everything. Tareas and Notas stay built behind the other tabs (the IndexedStack at main_shell.dart:26-35) and watch the task list. So every task change (completing one on Calendar, a save, a sync) re-runs their filters, and since P11 each run folds every open task's text and every note body, character by character, even with nothing typed. Voice notes keep up to 8,000 characters (capture_processor.dart:42,57). Before P11 it was one lowercase pass.
Fix: matchesSearch returns true at once when the query is empty, before folding anything (text_search.dart:4-5). The four fields already trim what's typed, so a query of spaces arrives empty.

While you're in foldForSearch, keep it one pass that doesn't create a String per character (today it calls String.fromCharCode for every rune): write ASCII code units straight through and look up only the rest. That gives the typing step of the device check some headroom; the cost is inferred from the code, not measured.

Keep: the accent map (text_search.dart:21-44), folding both sides (an accented query still finds plain text), and every existing test. Not here: the time-zone filter (regional_settings_screen.dart:156), which is UX-431, in P18.
acceptance: Unit test (App/test/text_search_test.dart): `matchesSearch('Reunió al col·legi', 'col·')`, `matchesSearch('col.legi', 'col.')` and `matchesSearch('Coŀlegi', 'coŀ')` are true.
Unit test: typed one character at a time, every prefix of `col·legi`, of `col.legi` and of `coŀlegi` finds each of `Reunió al col·legi`, `col.legi` and `Coŀlegi`.
Unit test: every existing UX-303 case in text_search_test.dart still passes, including the empty query matching everything, and `cafes` and `ano nuevo` finding nothing.

Widget test (extend the UX-303 test in App/test/notes_ui_test.dart): on Notas at 320×568 with 2× text, in es, ca and en, entering `col·` in the search lists `Reunió al col·legi` and doesn't show the no-match title (`noMatches`; CA `No hi ha tasques que coincideixin`).
Code: matchesSearch returns true for an empty query before calling foldForSearch, and foldForSearch no longer creates a String per character.
deviceChecks: Profile build on a low-end Android phone with about 300 notes of about 1,500 characters each: complete a task on Calendar, then type in the Notas search; neither causes a frame over 16 ms. Inferred from code.

decisions.question: When does the two-tab layout (Calendario + Listas, with Ajustes behind the avatar) get built? You approved it in principle (D7a), for after the capture fixes and the §7 test with your father.
decisions.recommendation: Unchanged: run the §7 test after this run, then decide. U10 and UX-331 wait on it as before, and UX-421's Catalan part now does too. P28 made the tab labels 12 sp; the reviewer measured Catalan `Configuració` at 103.7 dp selected and 98.1 dp unselected at 1.3× text, in an 80 dp tab on a 320 dp phone (93.6 dp at 11 sp). Four tabs can't hold it, and it's Android's own Catalan word for Settings, so renaming it isn't recommended. Two tabs give each tab 160 dp.
